title: Completed evaluation, transitions and projection adjunct
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite and $T$ a scheme in the same universe. Let $D$ be the exact abelian coefficient-tower presentation of [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian], and use [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]. Restrict each level through the commutative projection of [lem-sp-ell-coefficient-fiber] to $R=\mathcal O_{E,T}$. Define exact completed evaluation and its derived functor. Define the completed transition by its sectionwise equality to the original strict semilinear transition; define the derived transition by its localization factorization. Both characterizations are unique. For a derived tower $C$, a completed derived object $M$ and a product map $p:M\to\prod_n\operatorname{Res} C_n$, define the finite reduction arrow $M\otimes_R^L B_n\to C_n$ to be the tensor-restriction adjunct of $p$ followed by projection to level $n$, using the specified scalar model and adjunction. A fixed-universe specialization of the ordinary module-sheaf abelian structure preserves consumer instance inference when re-exporting the coefficient-fiber projection.
